scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Build OK — static frontend, no compilation needed')"
scripts.lint: ls backend/*.js backend/**/*.js frontend/js/*.js frontend/api/*.js frontend/api/**/*.js admin/js/*.js shared/*.js 2>/dev/null | xargs -n1 node --check && echo 'Lint OK'
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && echo 'All checks passed'
